conditions: An antiderivative is required on every connected component of this domain; additive constants may differ between components.
Li2 and ln use their principal branches.
ln is the principal complex logarithm, with ln(-r)=ln(r)+i*pi for positive real r.
Cover every connected component of the stated real domain, including both signs of the sine; intervalwise additive constants are immaterial.
Li2 is principal; its argument -(x^2+x)^2 lies on the nonpositive real axis.
The stationary substitution point x=-1/2 belongs to the domain and must not become a singularity.
atan is the ordinary real principal arctangent.
